scope: Two completed selected-action paths with exact 60-card introductory lists; no helper cards, forced destiny packs, phase skipping or mid-game state edits. Not exhaustive legal-action or full-card conformance.
replay: Reference runs use fresh GEMP random shuffles. Stored traces are fixed regression fixtures. Native setup uses recorded lawful Fisher-Yates choices giving the same opening hand and ordered Reserve; no later random or state correction.
comparison: Compare before each substantive action and at final result: ordered Reserve/Force/Used/Lost, unordered hands, location order within each system, table occupants, current Character power/ability/forfeit, and damage/initial attrition during loss payment. Separate system groups are normalized for layout.
harnessVersions: Ground A retains its exact executed earlier source. Ground B uses the current harness with exact ordinary-Draw label and hand-only deployment classification. Both traces validate selected raw action labels during native replay.
limits: The policy passes optional responses, deploys characters from hand, activates, draws, drains and battles. It does not choose Interrupts, equipment, movement, additional location deployment or special setup.
Fixture success does not compare every offered legal action, remaining attrition, every timing boundary or every card effect.
Unknown GEMP decisions and native mismatches fail replay. A fresh randomized reference run can require additional decision adapters.
Failed-destiny Obsession adjudication, remaining reachable interactions and broader full-engine/product scope remain required. Production deck admission stays closed.
